title: Reeded Glass
description: A Swiss poster, two words, a vermilion sun and a cobalt bar, behind a free-standing pane of reeded glass. Drag the pane sideways and every reed, a small cylindrical lens, turns its strip of the page over, so the letters and the sun re-slice rib by rib with a hairline highlight on each flute and a faint colour split at the edges. Flick it and it coasts and settles. Switch between even architectural reeds and hand-drawn painterly ones with shoulders and wobble.
intent: Glass refraction as the subject: one pane, one drag, and a seam that shows exactly where clear paper turns into fluted lens, so the re-slicing reads as an object passing over print rather than a filter.

sources.name: basement.studio, shader-lab fluted glass pass
sources.what: Apache-2.0. Ported the reed lens profile, max(0, 1 - u²)^1.08 x 0.7, the painterly body-plus-shoulder profile smoothstep(.08,.52,|u|)·(1 - smoothstep(.62,.98,|u|)) with band and warp noise, and the per-preset refraction strength (1.7 architectural, 2.7 painterly).

sources.what: Apache-2.0. The pow(x, 1.3) shadow across each flute and the hairline highlight at the rib edge, which together sell the glass with no chrome.
